column1: # The names %h<sha256> and the file .name (the event journal contract, «File names in shared trees»): reading — a directory entry → the original component or @skip; writing — the component and the present .name → write, keep or refuse. The form — README.

column4: a component of 240 bytes: 240 + 16 > 255 — written as a hash, .name matches
236 + .lock 5 + 16 > 255 — a hash with the norm's suffix
no .name — the entry is skipped with a count
sha256 of the content of .name is not equal to the name
239 + 16 = 255 — not longer than 255: such a component is written as is, a hash is not by the norm
40 «я»: encoded %d1%8f… — 240 characters, 240 + 16 > 255 — a hash by the norm; the threshold — by the encoded length, not by the UTF-8 bytes
no .name — the writer writes it (the content is given by the key)
.name exists and does not match — a write refusal without overwriting: damage, not a collision
